parsed.note_claim: Ana Brnabić has been criticized for dismissing substantiated evidence that students had been subjected to unauthorized surveillance and spyware targeting.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Ana Brnabić, the parliamentary speaker and a ranking member of the ruling Serbian Progressive party, denied that students had been spied on. "Absolutely not," she said. "I do not believe a single word they've [students, Share] said."
parsed.reason: The page confirms students were targeted with spyware via forensic analysis and quotes Brnabić explicitly denying these substantiated claims.
